decisions.reason: This finned tube product is closely related to the firm's core heat-exchanger knowledge and manufacturing capabilities, and given the firm's strong in-house R&D, broad portfolio, and survival past the initial launch period, management would likely retain it while continuing incremental improvement.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build very directly on the firm's existing technical base and can be learned from and commercialized across multiple established applications, so a German machinery firm with strong absorptive capacity would be inclined to keep the product rather than withdraw it.
